title: pleopeltis millisora
intro: Pleopeltis millisora, commonly known as the resurrection fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. It is known for its unique ability to survive long periods of drought by curling up its fronds and drying out, only to regain its green color and resume growth when water becomes available. The resurrection fern is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and boost the immune system. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
